reviews.text: Attended the puppy foundation course.  Sarah has a great depth of knowledge which she shared with the course participants.  We covered the basics of training and we were given helpful notes to remind us of what to practise between sessions.  Sarah was patient and encouraging when things didn't go quite according to plan.

We had the best time on our puppy foundation course! Sarah is a great trainer, shows you exactly how to do the training properly and feeds back on how you are doing it until you get it right. The training covered everything you need to get started with your puppy and they pick it up so easily too. Thank you Sarah for the classes, we loved them all and have been enjoying continuing them at home! We hope for the next stage course shortly for us to join ❤️🤞
We had a great time at Sarah's puppy classes- fun but informative, so supportive and reassuring! Thanks so much Sarah and Sam - here's to a well behaved puppy (sometime in the next 2 years)!

Honey and I have had an amazing time doing the puppy foundation course with Sarah. Sarah makes the course what it is with her knowledge and great personality. She clearly loves what she does and this shows in her training. …
